author: Crimson_Aught
body:
Rendezvous 2 Meadows [CTW+DTM]
by Crimson Aught
Original built by Haribo98

Hello, finally I've released Rendesvous 2 remix. I called this version Meadows, because green - it is what was missing on that old grey map.
I have fully rebuilt spawns and wool rooms. Now you don't need to jump from its roof. Also I changed map's relief. And the main addition is a monument behind spawn (I'm not really sure about this. It is need to be tested in game).
Kits in wool rooms, loadouts, shape and size of map stayed almost the same.



Details

Gamemode: Capture the Wool and Destroy the Monument
Wool: Pink and Orange for Red team, Light Blue and Lime for Blue team
Monument: Back
Teams: Red vs Blue
Size: 360 blocks x 110 blocks

Images Download and XML (coming soon)

I hope, you like it. Or criticism is welcomed :D
